Same history and same fix as the sibling repulsive row Hubbard/square_64_P_32_8 AFQMC -33.642(5), whose reference was changed to the Science paper under the 2026-09-21 ruling (option a, corrections.mjs 'FP4-arxiv-2507-02644#2'); this entry applies that precedent to the eleven rows listed in qmbl-verify DECISIONS.md section 1 as '11 Hubbard (PRA 92, 033603) | the cited paper is a dilute continuum gas study', whose ruling (2026-09-16) was on hold because 'the premise is not established'; the PR #23 exchange (the uploader naming PRA 92 as the method paper) and the VarBench SM's own description of these runs establish it. This is a reference change only, not the rejected baseline/contributed flag. Energy, sigma and bound_type stay: the run is sign-problem-free (N_up = N_dn = 28 in the trial determinant), extrapolated to dt -> 0, so exact (stochastic) with its sigma. compute.reported_as: The Transformer architecture used in this work has n_l = 4 layers, h = 12 attention heads, and an embedding dimension of d = 72 (refer to Ref. [49] for more details about their role). || The variational states are optimized within the Variational Monte Carlo framework using Stochastic Reconfiguration (SR) with the linear algebra trick. The optimization is carried out for 4 x 10^4 steps without the symmetries, 2 x 10^3 steps when restoring the translational symmetry, and an additional 10^2 steps when restoring both translational and rotational symmetry. We use M = 2^13 Monte Carlo samples per iteration. The learning rate is initialized to eta = 0.03 and is gradually annealed during the optimization. || This work was supported as part of the "Swiss AI initiative" by a grant from the Swiss National Supercomputing Centre (CSCS) under project ID a117 on Alps.
